description: This Java source file defines a helper class named 'Log' for logging purposes. It provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert) and manages an internal linked list of LogNode objects to handle log message processing. The class serves as a wrapper and utility for Android's native logging facilities, enabling flexible chaining and forwarding of log messages.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for logging messages at various levels, managing LogNode chain, and providing a simplified interface for logging operations. It defines constants for log levels, maintains a static LogNode, and offers static methods to log messages with or without exceptions.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Retrieves the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle the log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message with a specific priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v (verbose)
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d (debug)
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i (info)
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w (warn)
methods.description: Logs a warning message or throwable.

methods.name: e (error)
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf (assert)
methods.description: Logs an assertion message or Throwable.
